cohort: 8228 newborn infants hospitalized for special care at 3 referral neonatal units (district, regional, and tertiary) in Greater Accra Region of Ghana in 2013 and 2014.
finding: There was a significant burden of neonatal morbidity and mortality among hospitalized newborns prior to the implementation of a national action plan.
followup_time: Time from hospital admission to discharge
birth_weight: Data available for 96.7% of infants; 48.5% were low birth weight (<2500g)
